name: Claudia
source:
The kingdom's princess and designated successor.
Fair-minded and upright, she is a model student who excels in both academics and sports.
She usually carries the atmosphere of a friendly and refined young lady.
Dislikes anything dishonest or crooked. While she is tolerant toward others, she is strict with herself, determined to become someone worthy of being queen.
